description: This Java class 'ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo' models and manages information about screen widgets in the OFBiz framework, including their associated entities, services, forms, and linked requests. It provides methods to populate and retrieve related artifacts and metadata.

classes.name: ScreenWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents and manages metadata and relationships for a screen widget in the OFBiz framework, including associated entities, services, forms, and linked requests.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates related artifacts such as services, entities, forms, and linked requests based on the model screen.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service artifacts used in the screen based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity artifacts used in the screen based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateFormsFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds form widget artifacts included in the screen based on a set of form names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Adds linked request artifacts based on a set of request unique IDs.
